summary: SunScout Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of its initial public offering of 3,100,000 Class A ordinary shares at $5.00 per share, with an underwriter's option for 465,000 additional shares. The offering was conducted on a firm commitment basis under a registration statement on Form F-1 declared effective August 11, 2026, with Dominari Securities LLC as representative. Shares began trading on NYSE American and NYSE Texas under ticker SNSC on August 12, 2026. This is a routine IPO closing report, not a special situation. No special-situation dynamics apply.
